task.description: Read docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-001a.md independently. Run WF-02 Step 3b's gate: (a) does each of REQ-001a's 5 acceptance criteria have at least one verification case? (b) no TODO left in the spec? (c) is each case precise enough to run without judgment — exact route, viewport, expected output, not 'check it looks right'? Pay attention to whether the spec's commands/breakpoints/commit-SHA references are still accurate against the current branch state (TEST-DESIGNER noted the exact commit SHA for one check might drift — verify whether that's handled sanely, e.g. by giving TEST-RUNNER a way to re-locate the right state rather than a SHA that could go stale).
acceptance_criteria: Checks a-c run against docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-001a.md directly
Confirm all 5 acceptance criteria are covered
Confirm no vague/judgment-requiring language anywhere in the spec

result.summary: Independently read docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-001a.md and re-ran the WF-02 Step 3b gate. (a) All 5 acceptance criteria (AC1-AC5) each have at least one precise, failing-on-violation verification case; confirmed by independently executing the underlying checks against the current branch state (curl route/redirect checks, grep on globals.css yielding exactly 3 '.lang' rules, LocaleSwitcher.tsx className grep, next-intl dependency placement, messages/ru.json and messages/uz.json presence). (b) grep -n "TODO" docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-001a.md returned no matches — no TODO left anywhere in the spec. (c) Every case specifies an exact route, exact viewport (600px/1024px or N/A with justification), and an exact expected string/exit-code/output — no 'check it looks right' language found anywhere. Specifically verified the flagged SHA-staleness concern: AC5 step 5 does not hardcode blind trust in commit 59596fc — it instructs TEST-RUNNER to first confirm the SHA via 'git log --oneline -- src/app/globals.css' and substitute the actual SHA found there if different. Independently ran that exact command: 59596fc is confirmed to still be the correct, sole REQ-001a implementation commit touching src/app/globals.css, and 'git show 59596fc -- src/app/globals.css' matches the spec's exact described diff (only '.lang span' renamed to '.lang a', no other change). This re-derivation approach is robust to a future rebase/squash/cherry-pick changing the SHA, so this is not a defect. Gate PASSES with no issues found.
